Gemini said

To use the real-time audio and translation models via the Live API, you cannot use standard request-response HTTP calls (like generateContent). Instead, the Live API relies on stateful WebSocket connections (wss://) to stream bidirectional audio, video, and text in real time.

The models you listed (such as Gemini Flash Live, Live Translate, and Extended Thinking variants) can be integrated using either the official SDKs (like the google-genai SDK) or raw WebSockets.

Method 1: Using the Google GenAI SDK (Recommended)

The official Google GenAI SDK provides high-level asynchronous helpers to manage the WebSocket connection, audio chunk streaming, and tool calls.

Install the SDK:

Bash
pip install google-genai


Initialize a Live Session (Python Example):

Python
import asyncio
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

client = genai.Client()

async def main():
    # Choose your model endpoint (e.g., gemini-3.8-live, gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview, etc.)
    model_id = "gemini-3.8-live"

    config = types.LiveConnectConfig(
        response_modalities=[types.LiveModality.AUDIO],
        speech_config=types.SpeechConfig(
            voice_config=types.VoiceConfig(
                prebuilt_voice_config=types.PrebuiltVoiceConfig(voice_name="Puck")
            )
        ),
    )

    async with client.aio.live.connect(model=model_id, config=config) as session:
        print("Connected to Gemini Live API!")

        # Example: Send a text prompt or stream real-time audio/video chunks
        await session.send(input="Hello, tell me a quick joke.", end_of_turn=True)

        # Listen for responses from the model
        async for response in session.receive():
            server_content = response.server_content
            if server_content and server_content.model_turn:
                for part in server_content.model_turn.parts:
                    # Handle incoming audio bytes or text transcripts
                    if part.inline_data:
                        audio_chunk = part.inline_data.data
                        # Play or stream audio_chunk (raw 24kHz PCM)
                    if part.text:
                        print(part.text, end="")

asyncio.run(main())

Method 2: Connecting via Raw WebSockets (wss://)

If you are building a custom frontend or working in an environment without the official SDK, you can connect directly to the WebSocket endpoint.

Construct the WebSocket URL:

Plaintext
wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent?key=YOUR_API_KEY


Send the Setup Message:The very first message sent over the WebSocket connection must be a configuration setup JSON object:

JSON
{
  "setup": {
    "model": "models/gemini-3.8-live",
    "responseModalities": ["AUDIO"],
    "systemInstruction": {
      "parts": [{"text": "You are a helpful real-time voice assistant."}]
    }
  }
}


Stream Real-Time Inputs:

Audio In: Must be sent as raw 16-bit PCM audio, 16kHz, little-endian, base64-encoded.

Text/Control In: Sent via realtimeInput or clientContent payloads.

Technical Specifications for Audio Streams

Input Audio Format: Raw 16-bit PCM audio, 16kHz, little-endian (mono).

Output Audio Format: Raw 16-bit PCM audio, 24kHz, little-endian (mono).

Video/Vision Input (if applicable): JPEG frames at up to 1 FPS streamed alongside your audio channel.

Gemini said

To use gemini-3.8-live in text mode inside agy-open, you do not need to modify agy-open itself. Instead, run a local Python bridge script that exposes a standard OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint ([http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions](http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions)) and translates requests over WebSockets to the Gemini Live API.

Important API Requirement for Text Mode

gemini-3.8-live strictly requires response_modalities=["AUDIO"] (passing ["TEXT"] throws an API error). To get text out of it:

Send your prompt as standard text via send_client_content.

Enable "output_audio_transcription": {} in the session setup.

Discard the incoming PCM audio bytes and collect the server_content.output_transcription.text stream.

Set a system_instruction telling the model to speak cleanly without conversational filler so the transcript formats well as text.

Step 1: Install Dependencies

Create a virtual environment and install the official SDK plus a minimal HTTP server:

Bash
pip install google-genai fastapi uvicorn

Step 2: Create the Local Bridge (live_proxy.py)

Save this script. It handles both streaming (stream: true) and non-streaming (stream: false) requests from agy-open.

Python
import os
import json
import time
import asyncio
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, StreamingResponse
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

app = FastAPI()
client = genai.Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY"),
    http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}
)

def build_live_config(system_prompt: str | None = None) -> dict:
    base_instruction = (
        "You are operating in a terminal text interface. "
        "Your spoken output is being transcribed directly to text. "
        "Be concise, direct, and avoid vocal filler words."
    )
    if system_prompt:
        base_instruction = f"{base_instruction}\n\n{system_prompt}"

    return {
        "response_modalities": ["AUDIO"],
        "output_audio_transcription": {},
        "system_instruction": {
            "parts": [{"text": base_instruction}]
        }
    }

def format_messages(messages: list[dict]) -> tuple[str | None, list[dict]]:
    system_parts = []
    turns = []
    for msg in messages:
        role = msg.get("role", "user")
        content = msg.get("content", "")
        if isinstance(content, list):
            content = "\n".join(p.get("text", "") for p in content if p.get("type") == "text")

        if role == "system":
            system_parts.append(content)
        else:
            gemini_role = "model" if role == "assistant" else "user"
            turns.append({"role": gemini_role, "parts": [{"text": content}]})

    system_text = "\n".join(system_parts) if system_parts else None
    return system_text, turns

@app.post("/v1/chat/completions")
async def chat_completions(request: Request):
    body = await request.json()
    model_id = body.get("model", "gemini-3.8-live")
    messages = body.get("messages", [])
    stream = body.get("stream", False)

    system_text, turns = format_messages(messages)
    config = build_live_config(system_text)

    if stream:
        async def event_stream():
            async with client.aio.live.connect(model=model_id, config=config) as session:
                await session.send_client_content(turns=turns, turn_complete=True)
                async for response in session.receive():
                    sc = response.server_content
                    if sc and sc.output_transcription and sc.output_transcription.text:
                        chunk = {
                            "id": f"chatcmpl-{int(time.time())}",
                            "object": "chat.completion.chunk",
                            "created": int(time.time()),
                            "model": model_id,
                            "choices": [{
                                "index": 0,
                                "delta": {"content": sc.output_transcription.text},
                                "finish_reason": None
                            }]
                        }
                        yield f"data: {json.dumps(chunk)}\n\n"
                    if sc and sc.turn_complete:
                        break

            done_chunk = {
                "id": f"chatcmpl-{int(time.time())}",
                "object": "chat.completion.chunk",
                "created": int(time.time()),
                "model": model_id,
                "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}]
            }
            yield f"data: {json.dumps(done_chunk)}\n\n"
            yield "data: [DONE]\n\n"

        return StreamingResponse(event_stream(), media_type="text/event-stream")

    # Non-streaming response
    full_text = []
    async with client.aio.live.connect(model=model_id, config=config) as session:
        await session.send_client_content(turns=turns, turn_complete=True)
        async for response in session.receive():
            sc = response.server_content
            if sc and sc.output_transcription and sc.output_transcription.text:
                full_text.append(sc.output_transcription.text)
            if sc and sc.turn_complete:
                break

    return JSONResponse({
        "id": f"chatcmpl-{int(time.time())}",
        "object": "chat.completion",
        "created": int(time.time()),
        "model": model_id,
        "choices": [{
            "index": 0,
            "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "".join(full_text)},
            "finish_reason": "stop"
        }]
    })

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=8000)

Step 3: Run and Point agy-open to Localhost

Start the bridge:

Bash
export GEMINI_API_KEY="your_api_key_here"
python live_proxy.py


Configure agy-open:
Point agy-open's custom OpenAI-compatible provider/base URL to:

Base URL: [http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1](http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1)

API Key: dummy (the proxy reads GEMINI_API_KEY from its own environment, or you can modify the script to read the Authorization header passed by agy-open)

Model slug: gemini-3.8-live (or gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking)

Practical Caveat with Text-via-Audio Transcription

Because the model generates spoken audio internally and transcribes it, punctuation, code blocks, and special symbols (like {} or --flags) may occasionally be transcribed phonetically or lose formatting compared to native text models. It works great for general Q&A, translation, summarization, and brainstorming, though you should double-check exact syntax if asking it to generate shell commands or Python code.
